title: Plan-context coherence and hierarchical freshness
summary: Make resumed work aware of sibling capabilities and keep parent descriptions reconciled with child changes.
description: Remediate plan-context coherence gaps across packages/plan-core/src/recap.ts, packages/plan-core/src/handoff-context.ts, packages/plan-core/src/plan-store.ts, packages/pi-adapter/src/index.ts, packages/plan-mcp/src/index.ts, and the managed planner skill. Current handoff and task-resume context can omit sibling tasks and related planned capabilities in the active phase, causing agents to propose work already tracked elsewhere. Task or phase description changes can also leave parent phase/feature descriptions stale or contradictory. Add bounded sibling/related-capability context at prepare/load/start boundaries and deterministic hierarchical freshness diagnostics or reconciliation without silently rewriting user-authored descriptions. Preserve composite references, bounded handoff transport, agent-only context separation, harness parity, and explicit user ownership of semantic plan content.

tasks.title: Include sibling tasks and related planned capabilities in resume context
tasks.description:
Strengthen resume and handoff context across packages/plan-core/src/handoff-context.ts, packages/plan-core/src/recap.ts, packages/pi-adapter/src/index.ts, packages/plan-mcp/src/index.ts, and packages/plan-core/planner-skill.md. Agents resuming one task currently receive its checkpoint but can miss sibling tasks and related capabilities already planned in the same phase, leading to duplicate or contradictory proposals. Add a bounded, priority-ordered phase work map with sibling task refs, statuses, concise goals, dependencies, and remaining capability ownership to handoff prepare/show and task resume/start guidance. tasks.title: Prevent false handoff-completeness and active-task claims
tasks.description:
Fix two release regressions in the cold-start contract. Current state: `packages/plan-core/src/handoff-context.ts:285-440` validates submitted audit strings and exact inventory echoes but a writer can still omit material history, skip the required persisted read-back, and later discover real gaps; `plugins/_shared/planner-skill.md.in` and generated copies describe verification but do not make an unverified write visibly non-final. Separately, `packages/plan-mcp/src/index.ts:418-454` returns counts and feature summaries from `planner-show` without an explicit active-task list or authoritative `none` state, allowing agents to infer “no active task” from absent task detail even when an in-progress task exists. Strengthen the handoff write/verification outcome so agents cannot report a handoff as resume-ready before a persisted read-back and concrete completeness check, preserve the canonical scaffold, bounded content, supporting-document contract, existing IDs/hashes/audit history, and Pi/MCP parity. Add explicit active-task evidence to compact overview/load surfaces and guidance: positive refs when active, an explicit verified-empty state when none, and conflict visibility when multiple tasks are active; never infer absence from counts or omitted fields. Update core, Pi/MCP surfaces, managed skill/template copies, and semantic regressions. Edge cases: multiple active tasks, checkpoint-only resumes, pending handoffs without active tasks, stale handoff tokens, terminal phases, empty plans, and backward-compatible reads of existing handoff audit data.

---
**Completion summary:**
Implemented and verified the release-truthfulness regression fix. Handoff writes in `packages/pi-adapter/src/index.ts` and `packages/plan-mcp/src/index.ts` now persist only a candidate and return `persisted:true`, `resumeReady:false`, and mandatory read-back next actions. Added semantic `PlanStore.verifyPhaseHandoffReadBack` in `packages/plan-core/src/plan-store.ts` plus validation in `packages/plan-core/src/handoff-context.ts`: the new Pi `handoff_verify` and MCP `planner-handoff-verify` require the exact persisted content hash, a second substantive review of conversation/planner/working-tree/runtime/peer sources, and an empty omissions list; discovered gaps return `HANDOFF_READBACK_GAPS_FOUND` and cannot mark the handoff ready. `packages/plan-core/src/schema.ts` stores backward-compatible `resumeReadyAt` and read-back source evidence; compact handoff lists, show responses, recap text, and the Web UI handoff route expose verification-required versus resume-ready state. `planner-show`, Pi `/planner show`, Pi `plan_get`, and shared recap logic now report authoritative active refs, an explicit verified-empty state, or a multiple-active conflict instead of permitting inference from omitted task detail. Updated `plugins/_shared/planner-skill.md.in`, synchronized core/Claude copies, `README.md`, surface/scenario inventories, and core/Pi/MCP/Web UI/Playwright regressions. Verification passed: `pnpm build`, `pnpm check`, `pnpm test:coverage` (561/561 Node tests and 94/94 Web UI tests; line 86.42%, branch 74.08%, functions 82.50%), `pnpm plugins:check`, `pnpm exec playwright test e2e/handoff-resume.spec.ts e2e/responsive.spec.ts` (10/10), and `git diff --check`. No known remaining work for T384; the previously paused T369 Accepted Decisions parity work remains preserved as the return target. No commit, push, PR, or merge was performed.

tasks.title: Externalize oversized handoffs and open Markdown references in Web UI
tasks.description:
Redesign long-context recovery, Markdown navigation, and Web UI startup parity across `packages/plan-core/src/handoff-context.ts`, `packages/plan-core/src/plan-store.ts`, `packages/pi-adapter/src/index.ts`, `packages/plan-mcp/src/index.ts`, `packages/plan-server/src/serve.ts`, `packages/plan-web-ui/src/`, shared planner skill copies, and cross-surface tests. Current failure is structural: real handoffs approach the 24,000-character ceiling while still omitting resume-critical facts; the generated operational audit is embedded in the handoff Markdown and duplicated again in structured `handoffAudit` metadata; free-text category coverage and same-agent `omissionsFound: []` behave as self-attestation rather than proof. MCP Web UI startup also lacks Pi parity because its successful start response does not clearly expose the reachable Web UI address.

Build a compact resume-capsule contract for new writes: target at most 8,000 inline characters, keep 24,000 only as a backward-compatible absolute read/write safety ceiling, and automatically externalize extended detail before the target is exceeded. The inline handoff must contain only the exact focus, first resume action, partial/current state, blockers/risks, ordered supporting-document links, and minimal preservation constraints. Do not embed the verbose completeness audit or cold-start inventory in Markdown; retain them once as structured metadata. Derive canonical evidence such as active task, phase, planner refs, branch/worktree state where available, persisted supporting-document hashes, and completed verification from authoritative sources instead of asking the agent to narrate duplicates. Persist planner-owned Markdown safely, retain a substantive inline summary and `supportingDocuments`, and either complete the write automatically or return one immediately executable typed continuation operation—never a dead-end size error or a false completeness claim. `resumeReady` must require persisted evidence and deterministic required fields; same-agent free-text attestation alone is insufficient. Add a cold-resume acceptance regression proving a fresh reader can identify the exact task, resume point, relevant files/documents, and next commands without conversation history.

Detect valid planner-local Markdown references in shared formatted content and render accessible links that open a path-safe Markdown viewer in a new tab. Research a lightweight maintained editor library, using a dependency-free textarea plus existing Markdown preview as the baseline; add an explicitly confirmed save path only if justified. Restrict reads and writes to approved planner documentation roots and reject traversal and symlink escapes. Preserve existing handoff IDs, content hashes, audit history, legacy handoff parsing, source-review/cold-start metadata, supporting-document behavior, text/layout for non-reference content, and closed-by-default disclosures. Make MCP Web UI start responses match Pi behavior by returning and visibly printing the actual reachable Web UI address, with typed structured address/host/port metadata and tests for local/LAN startup. Cover plan-core, Pi, MCP, server, Web UI, shared skill guidance, capability inventory, unit/integration tests, and desktop/mobile Playwright behavior.

---
**Completion summary:**
Implemented the T385 compact handoff and Markdown navigation redesign. New writes target a <=8,000-character resume capsule (Current focus, Current and partial state, Preservation constraints, Supporting documents, Blockers and risks, How to resume) with 24,000 kept only as the absolute compatibility ceiling; verbose audit/inventory stay once as structured metadata and are never embedded in Markdown. Oversized writes auto-externalize the full body to one planner-owned .planner/docs/handoff-*.md document and complete the write with the auto doc in supportingDocuments (never a dead-end size error). Planner-owned doc persistence rejects traversal and symlink escapes in PlanStore and server; GET /api/docs/view and PUT /api/docs/save (confirmed=true, creates parent dirs) back the Web UI /docs/view viewer with dependency-free textarea plus live preview. Shared FormattedText linkifies valid .planner/docs/*.md references as new-tab accessible links. MCP planner-web start/status/stop and planner-load now return visible reachable addresses plus typed running/address/host/port metadata (Pi parity). Editor research evaluated @uiw/react-md-editor and CodeMirror 6 and shipped the dependency-free textarea baseline (recorded in code and README). Updated skill guidance, README, capability surfaces, and fixtures. Verification: core handoff/context suites 57/57 incl. new externalization/cold-resume/symlink tests; server CRUD 24/24 incl. docs traversal/confirmed-save; MCP handoff/web/harness 36/36 incl. structured address; Pi mutations/registration 34/34; Web UI vitest 102/102 incl. doc links; matrix/skill-inventory 15/15; agent-plan version 7/7; compatibility 15/15; pnpm build/check/plugins:check/diff-check clean; Playwright responsive 8/8 incl. new doc-viewer scenario. tasks.title: Allow concurrent task starts across agent sessions
tasks.description:
Current state: task_start in packages/pi-adapter/src/index.ts and packages/plan-mcp/src/index.ts delegates to global recommendNextTask/checkExplicitTaskStart logic, so an already in-progress task owned by another agent/session is reported as ACTIVE_TASK_CONFLICT. The suggested task_switch path snapshots and moves that other task back to planned, incorrectly interrupting concurrent work. Implement durable session-aware active-task ownership in harness-agnostic plan-core schema/store/lifecycle helpers, then update Pi and MCP task_start/task_switch behavior so different sessions may hold different in-progress tasks concurrently while task_switch remains required only when the requesting session intentionally leaves its own active task. Preserve existing task statuses, status history, context-read attestations, priority/deviation advisories, resume checkpoints, legacy planner compatibility, and authoritative active-task overview evidence. Add core, Pi, MCP, multi-process, persisted read-back, and release-surface regressions proving a second agent can start another eligible task without pausing/demoting the first; the same session still receives explicit switch guidance when appropriate; failed starts are atomic no-ops; and multiple active tasks are surfaced as valid concurrent ownership rather than an automatic corruption claim.

---
**Completion summary:**
Shipped session-aware concurrent task-start ownership across plan-core, plan-mcp, and pi-adapter, with supporting plan-server ownership plumbing. `recommendNextTask` now accepts a session id and prefers tasks owned by that session; PlanStore normalizes inactive ownership away and preserves ownerSession on resume; MCP and Pi task start/switch paths pass the planner session id, stamp activeOwnerSession on started tasks, and reject switching away from another session's in-progress task. Verified with focused builds for @agent-plan/core, @agent-plan/mcp, @agent-plan/pi-adapter, targeted concurrency regressions in core/MCP/Pi, and `git diff --check`. Remaining unverified work is broader phase-level regression coverage outside the targeted concurrency cases; no commit/push/PR performed.

tasks.title: Enforce bounded verification and installed-artifact release gates
tasks.description:
Add durable, mechanically enforced development and release verification discipline across AGENTS.md, package.json, scripts/, and .github/workflows/ci.yml. Current workflows invite repeated broad pnpm build/check/test:coverage/Playwright runs, stream very large logs into agent context, lack a content-fingerprint success cache, and primarily validate workspace dist rather than freshly packed and installed public artifacts. Implement a canonical verification runner with focused and final modes; capture verbose command logs to planner-local or OS-temporary files while printing concise summaries/failure excerpts; reuse a successful final result only when the relevant source fingerprint is unchanged; prevent accidental repeated full gates during a task; and add clean temporary-install smoke coverage for packed core/MCP/server/CLI/Pi artifacts with fresh Pi/MCP cold-start flows including planner-load recap/Web UI metadata and terminal-phase handoff/document discoverability. Wire CI and release pre-flight to the same contract without weakening existing coverage thresholds, Playwright coverage, plugin synchronization, clean-tree rules, unified versioning, or user-only commit/push/PR/merge authority. All temporary installs and planner fixtures must use mkdtemp and never touch another real project.

---
**Completion summary:**
Implemented mechanically bounded verification and installed-artifact release gates. Added scripts/verify.mjs with focused package/test modes, a canonical final gate, complete log capture without streaming, bounded failure excerpts, repository content fingerprinting, unchanged-success reuse, and unchanged-failure blocking until a focused fix changes the fingerprint. Added scripts/installed-artifact-smoke.mjs, which packs all five public packages, installs tarballs into an mkdtemp application, exercises installed CLI/core/server/Pi registration and real MCP stdio planner-load, verifies structured recap plus typed Web UI address/host/port, and proves a terminally archived phase handoff still exposes its linked .planner/docs closeout reference. Wired package scripts, stable and next release scripts, and CI to the canonical final gate; CI uploads bounded verification evidence. Persisted non-negotiable cost/release rules in AGENTS.md and documented usage in README.md. Hardened MCP planner-load structuredContent so hosts that prioritize structured output receive loaded, recap, and webUi metadata rather than only agent skill context. Pi and MCP handoff_show now recover the latest done/rejected/canceled phase archive while active handoff lists remain active-only. Updated canonical/generated planner skill guidance, capability inventory, and targeted regressions. Verification: focused runner/release/MCP/Pi/inventory tests passed; packed-install smoke passed. The first canonical final run correctly stopped with a bounded excerpt for one obsolete skill-copy expectation; after a focused 14/14 fix, one final rerun passed build, typecheck, coverage 573/573, Web UI 96/96, plugin synchronization, Playwright 40/40, packed-install smoke, and git diff --check. tasks.title: Reconcile next-task recommendations with handoff and unblocked-work claims
tasks.description:
Current state: `packages/plan-core/src/task-recommendation.ts` (and the Pi/MCP recommendation handlers that expose it) selects ready work primarily by feature → phase → task priority. It does not reconcile active or terminal archived handoffs, paused/mid-flight phase context, explicitly deferred work whose blocking phase/task is now terminal, or other durable resume claims. This can return one nominal priority winner while planner handoffs identify unfinished or newly unblocked work that a fresh agent should evaluate first. Build a harness-agnostic recommendation model that returns the priority recommendation together with bounded, typed competing claims from authoritative persisted sources: active/pending handoffs, latest terminal archives where they contain explicit next/resume work, paused/resume-required tasks, and dependency transitions that make deferred work ready. Do not infer from timestamps or free-form prose when structured evidence is absent; distinguish recommendation, advisory claim, conflict, and insufficient evidence. Pi and MCP must expose equivalent structured evidence and human guidance instead of claiming one unqualified “next” task. Preserve feature → phase → task priority as a transparent policy signal, exact composite refs, derived-status governance, transport bounds, and user choice. Add focused core/Pi/MCP regressions for priority-only, unfinished-phase, newly-unblocked, multiple-claim, stale-handoff, terminal/no-action, and no-evidence cases, plus capability-surface documentation and the canonical final verification gate.

---
**Completion summary:**
Implemented a bounded next-work claims model in `packages/plan-core/src/task-selection.ts`: `recommendNextWork` now returns `claims` alongside the priority recommendation, with typed claim sources for active tasks, resume deviations, dependency-ready work, active handoffs, archived handoffs, and insufficient evidence. Pi and MCP `task_recommend`/`planner-task-recommend` now load active handoff content plus archived handoffs, surface the claims in structured output and human text, and preserve the existing priority-selected chain. Added focused regressions in `packages/plan-core/test/task-selection.test.mjs`, `packages/plan-mcp/test/mcp-handoff.test.mjs`, and `packages/pi-adapter/test/ref-validation.test.mjs` covering active handoff claims, archived handoff claims, dependency-ready selection claims, and the Pi session-start harness path. Verification completed successfully with `pnpm --filter @agent-plan/core build`, `pnpm --filter @agent-plan/mcp build`, `pnpm --filter @agent-plan/pi-adapter build`, `node --test packages/plan-core/test/task-selection.test.mjs`, `node --test packages/plan-mcp/test/mcp-handoff.test.mjs`, `node --test packages/pi-adapter/test/ref-validation.test.mjs`, and `git diff --check`.

---

Completed the typed next-work recommendation reconciliation. Core recommendations now expose bounded persisted-evidence claims for active work, deviations, verified active handoffs, and dependency-ready tasks; free-form handoff Markdown and terminal archives cannot create action claims. tasks.title: Make task reopening an atomic lifecycle operation
tasks.description:
Current state: reopening a completed task requires a caller to first use task_update to move it from done to planned and then retry task_start; when another task is active in the same session, that retry requires a separate task_switch that pauses unrelated work. The multi-step error guidance is implemented in packages/pi-adapter/src/index.ts:5585-5703 and packages/plan-mcp/src/index.ts:2154-2263, with lifecycle outcome codes in packages/plan-core/src/task-start-outcome.ts:1-20. Build one explicit, confirmation-gated semantic reopen operation in plan-core and expose equivalent Pi/MCP/server/Web UI flows. It must atomically retain prior completion evidence and status history, clear or version completion state consistently, establish the correct session owner only when appropriate, preserve concurrent-session work without demoting another owner, and return typed no-op/conflict/read-prerequisite outcomes. Do not make callers use raw task_update as a lifecycle workaround or silently pause an unrelated active task. Add core, Pi, MCP, server, and persisted-state regressions for done→reopened, confirmed versus unconfirmed, active same-session versus other-session work, retained completion audit, failures without mutation, and backward-compatible task reads.

---
**Completion summary:**
Implemented atomic, confirmation-gated task reopening across PlanStore, Pi, MCP, plan-server, and Web UI.
